# Wenbu · 问卜

> Free tools for BaZi, I Ching, tarot and Zi Wei. Deterministic calculations and random draws are separate from optional AI interpretation. Symbolic reflection is not factual prediction.

## Tools

- [Daily card](https://wenbu.app/en/daily/): a free, stable upright card for the current local date, one small action and a reflection prompt. No birth data, model call or signup required. Optional account save. `POST /api/v1/daily` with `{"action":"reveal","timezone":"Asia/Shanghai"}`; native clients may pass a stable random UUID `seed`. Without it, native clients receive the shared public card. No private account access via CLI or MCP.

- [Agent workspace](https://wenbu.app/en/agent/): Wenbu conversations, calculated charts and research from the Wenbu library and selected references. Guest history stays in the browser; optional verified email accounts can save chosen records. Sending a message shares the conversation and selected context with Wenbu’s model provider.
- [BaZi calculator](https://wenbu.app/en/bazi/): date, time, timezone and explicit calendar conventions
- [I Ching](https://wenbu.app/en/iching/): three-coin method with all changing lines
- [Tarot](https://wenbu.app/en/tarot/): full 78-card deck, one or three cards
- [Zi Wei](https://wenbu.app/en/ziwei/): twelve palaces and named calculation conventions

## Getting started

- [First reading](https://wenbu.app/en/learn/first-reading/): a complete first session with a worked example
- [Choose a tool](https://wenbu.app/en/learn/choose-a-tool/): conversation, symbolic draws or birth charts
- [Ask a better question](https://wenbu.app/en/learn/ask-a-better-question/): examples you can adapt
- [Prepare birth details](https://wenbu.app/en/learn/prepare-birth-details/): dates, recorded times and tool-specific inputs
- [Read AI answers with sources](https://wenbu.app/en/learn/read-ai-with-sources/): calculation facts, traditional interpretations and generated suggestions
- [Review a reading](https://wenbu.app/en/learn/review-a-reading/): save a note and return to it
- [Chinese library](https://wenbu.app/learn/): the same guides in Chinese

## Agent integration

- [Agent event protocol](https://wenbu.app/agent-protocol.md): explicit consent, selected context, SSE events and bounded execution
- [Capability manifest](https://wenbu.app/api/v1/capabilities): versioned tools, selectable prompts, conventions and privacy; no personal history access.
- [MCP endpoint](https://wenbu.app/mcp): stateless Streamable HTTP
- [Agent guide](https://wenbu.app/en/agents/)
- [OpenAPI schema](https://wenbu.app/openapi.json)
- [Skill](https://wenbu.app/SKILL.md)
- [CLI](https://wenbu.app/wenbu.mjs)
- [Context schema](https://wenbu.app/context.schema.json)

## Complete public knowledge exports

- [Bilingual knowledge index](https://wenbu.app/knowledge/index.json): the current complete guide catalogue, canonical URLs and language-specific full Markdown/JSON links.
- [Example Markdown guide](https://wenbu.app/knowledge/en/bazi-basics.md): complete text, diagram description, comparison table, worked example, glossary, FAQs and annotated sources.
- [Example structured guide](https://wenbu.app/knowledge/en/bazi-basics.json): schemaVersion, outline and the same editorial content.

MCP resource `wenbu://knowledge` supplies the index. `read_library` returns full guides without implicit truncation; optional `section` selects an outline ID and returns `scope:section`. Each section has its own citation ID, `guide-<slug>#<section>`. Preserve canonical URL, language, update date, editorial status and source scope. Reading an editorial guide does not mean its external references were fetched or verified. These exports contain no personal context.
